name: Hindsight
description: Hindsight is an AI-ready layer on top of your GTM data. It turns scattered, noisy revenue data — calls, emails, CRM notes, documents — into one verified record per deal that AI agents can reason over directly. The Hindsight MCP's deal search tools enable AI agents to search and select context from deals efficiently using a mix of semantic search and structured queries, allowing for simpler and more accurate workflows. The Knowledge Base tools allow you to provide your messaging, playbooks, and context. The Data Analysis tools allow you to create structured reports for things like win-loss analysis. Admins can use the MCP to manage context within the Hindsight platform.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Hindsight to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hindsight to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.usehindsight.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hindsight MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hindsight lists 18 MCP tools, including analyze_dealgrid_subset, create_dataset, fetch_hindsight_context, get_deal, map_site_urls, pull_full_document, pull_schema, scrape_url, search_across_deals, search_competitive_assets, search_competitive_intel, and search_deal_documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hindsight?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hindsight in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Hindsight requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Hindsight is developed by Hindsight. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
